posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Make event that checks button presses an increases variables and use show picture to show the pic of the cursor moving. Then when you're close to the pipe pics, check if you press action button and if so then you change the cursor pic to one with the correct pipe pic and use same method to move it around. Then when you're moving the pipe pic, if you press action button close to a missing pipe spot (define the spot with variable limits) then you show the pic of the pipe there and change cursor pic back to normal. If you press action button again there, you show the pipe pic in another orientation. And you control variables depending on if the pipe pics are in the correct spot and what orientation they are. If all variables show what you want, then you show text 'success' and erase all pics.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: You have a parallel event that checks up/down/left/right key presses. You have variables x and y. The keypresses add or subtract to those variables. Then in the parallel event you also keep showing a pic of the cursor in those variable coordinates with show picture. You make limits so that if the variables get bigger than the screen size, then you set them to the min/max values. Then you also check for action button press. Define areas there x>? && x<? && y>? && y<? Then when the action button is pressed and if you're inside of that defined area, you make something happen. Like change the cursor/pipe pics.
